verdict.rationale: The evidence shows instructions are reachable without an account: GOV.UK serves its business guidance (e.g. set-up-business) as keyless JSON with HTTP 200. Paper forms exist only by implication, from the line "file certain documents online instead of posting a paper form"; nothing shows the forms themselves can be downloaded, with or without an account. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of downloadable Companies House forms, confirmation that form downloads need no login, form-specific guidance notes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
